expr:
((max by (ct_id) (
  (
    pve_uptime_seconds{job="pve_uptime",ct_id!=""} >= 0
    and (pve_uptime_seconds{job="pve_uptime",ct_id!=""} < Inf)
    and on(job,instance,id,ct_id) (pve_up{job="pve_uptime"} == 1)
    and (time() - timestamp(pve_uptime_seconds{job="pve_uptime",ct_id!=""}) <= 45)
    and on(job,instance) (up{job="pve_uptime"} == 1)
  )
  and on(ct_id) (count by(ct_id)(pve_uptime_seconds{job="pve_uptime",ct_id!=""}) == 1)
)) and on(ct_id) (0*(max by(ct_id,service)(label_replace(up{job="node_exporter",vmid=~"${lxc:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"},"ct_id","$1","vmid","(.+)")) or max by(ct_id,service)(lxc:cpu_inventory:expected{ct_id=~"${lxc:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"})))) or (max by(ct_id)(0*(max by(ct_id,service)(label_replace(up{job="node_exporter",vmid=~"${lxc:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"},"ct_id","$1","vmid","(.+)")) or max by(ct_id,service)(lxc:cpu_inventory:expected{ct_id=~"${lxc:regex}",service=~"${service:regex}"})))-1)
expected_scope: existing dynamic monitored LXC inventory; no manual CT list
